column2: {n} already found a roommate.
Security cameras are offline
The home security app shows every camera offline. {He} never fixed them.
Offer to set up {his} cameras
You "fixed" {n}'s cameras. They record nothing, and you have the only login.
{n} said a technician is coming next week.
Wants friends badly
The search history says "how to make friends as an adult" over and over.
Become {his} first real friend
You became the friend {n} was searching for. {He} lets you drive {him} everywhere.
You came on too strong. {n} said {he} needed some space.
Birdwatches at dawn
A birdwatching forum with posts from {n} about the empty marsh {he} visits at dawn.
Ask to go birdwatching
{n} brought you to {his} secret birdwatching spot. It's silent out there before sunrise.
You couldn't name a single bird. {n} lost interest.
Takes night classes
Enrollment emails for evening classes that let out at 10 PM.
Enroll in {his} night class
You sat next to {n} in night class. You walk {him} to {his} car every week now.
The class was full.
Works alone on weekends
An email from {his} boss: "Thanks for covering the office alone again this weekend."
Drop by {his} office on a weekend
You brought {n} lunch at the empty office on Saturday. {He} said it's nice to have company.
Security wouldn't let you into the building.
Rents kayaks
Kayak rental receipts for the reservoir, always the early slot.
Ask {him} to go kayaking
You paddled out on the reservoir with {n} at dawn. Not another soul was out there.
You tipped your kayak over in the first five minutes.
On an insomnia forum
A forum post from {n}: "My sleeping pills knock me out so hard I wouldn't wake up for a fire alarm."
{n} told you all about {his} sleep routine. You know exactly when {he} is out cold.
{n} didn't want to talk about {his} sleep problems.
Has concert tickets for one
An email with one ticket to a concert next month.
Buy a ticket to the same concert
You "happened" to be at the same concert. You and {n} danced together and left together.
The concert sold out before you could get a ticket.
Volunteers at a shelter
A volunteer signup page for the animal shelter with {n}'s closing shifts highlighted.
Sign up for the same shifts
You started closing the shelter with {n}. It's just the two of you there after hours.
The shelter had no openings for new volunteers.

Wants a best friend
Page after page in {his} diary says the same thing: "I just want one person who actually cares."
Be the best friend {he} always wanted
You became the friend {n} always wrote about. {He} tells you everything now.
{n} said {he} has trust issues and needs time.
Scared of walking home alone
A diary entry: "Walked home in the dark again. I always feel like someone is watching me."
Offer to walk {him} home at night
{n} gratefully lets you walk {him} home every night now. {He} has no idea {he} was right about being watched.
{n} said {he} already bought pepper spray.
Crush on a coworker
Three whole pages in {his} diary are about a crush at work.
Pretend to be friends with {his} crush
You told {n} you know {his} crush and offered to put in a good word. {He} meets you after work to talk about it.
{n} asked {his} crush about you. The crush had never heard of you.
Feels invisible
The last diary entry just says "Nobody would even notice if I disappeared."
Make {him} feel noticed
You paid {n} more attention than anyone ever has. {He} lights up whenever you're around.
{n} found all the attention a little overwhelming.
Sleeps through anything
A diary entry: "Took two sleeping pills again. Slept through the smoke alarm test. Oops."
Ask about {his} sleep
{n} laughed about how hard {he} sleeps and told you {his} whole bedtime routine.
{n} didn't feel like talking about it.
Loves the lake at night
The lake at midnight is the only place my head goes quiet, {he} wrote.
Tell {him} you love the lake at night too
{n} invited you to {his} midnight spot by the water. It's completely deserted.
{n} said {his} spot is a secret.
Wants to learn to dance
A diary entry about signing up for an evening dance class and being too nervous to go alone.
You and {n} are dance partners now. Class ends late, and you always walk out together.
{n} chickened out of the class completely.
Goes everywhere alone
I hate crowds. I take the long way home through the park just to avoid people.
{n} likes walking the quiet way with you. Nobody else is ever on that path.
{n} said the whole point is being alone.
Leaves {his} window open
I always sleep with the bedroom window open. I can't stand stuffy rooms.
Talk about fresh air at night
{n} laughed and said {his} window is always open, even in winter.
{n} found the topic oddly specific.
Dreams of a road trip
Someday I'm going to get in a car and just drive somewhere nobody knows me.
Offer to take {him} on a road trip
{n} said yes immediately. You're picking {him} up on Saturday and driving somewhere nobody knows either of you.
{n} said "someday" means "not with you."
Only feels safe at church
Church is the only place I feel safe anymore. I stay late after everyone leaves.
Start going to {his} church
You started staying late after church with {n}. It's just the two of you in the empty pews.
{n} switched to the early service.
Wants to throw a party
I've never had a real party. I'm scared nobody would come.
Promise to come to {his} party
You helped {n} plan {his} first party. {He} trusts you to stay late and help clean up.
{n} cancelled the party out of nerves.
Runs to clear {his} head
Ran at 5 AM again. The streets are empty and it's the only time I feel free.
Join {his} early runs
You and {n} run the empty streets together before dawn now.
{n} said {he} only runs alone.
Terrified of the dark
The power went out again. I sat in the closet until it came back on.
Comfort {him} about it
{n} said you're the first person {he}'s ever told about {his} fear. {He} trusts you now.
{n} was embarrassed you brought it up.
Counting down to a camping trip
14 days until my solo camping trip. No phone, no people, nothing.
Ask to tag along camping
{n} agreed to let you come along on {his} "solo" trip. No phone. No people. Nothing.
{n} said the whole point is going solo.
Yoga every Tuesday
Every single Tuesday is marked "YOGA 7PM" in thick marker.
Join {his} yoga class
You rolled out your mat next to {n} on Tuesday. You walk out of class together every week now.
You fell over in the first pose. {n} tried not to laugh.
Goes to church every Sunday
Every Sunday is circled with the word "church."
Show up at {his} church
You sat next to {n} at church. {He} introduced you to everyone as {his} new friend.
You sang the wrong hymn very loudly. {n} moved pews.
Goes to a support group
Thursdays say "group" with a little heart drawn next to it.
Join {his} support group
You shared a made-up sob story at {n}'s group. {He} lets you walk {him} home afterward.
The group leader asked you to leave after you contradicted your own story.
Never misses trivia night
Every Wednesday says "TRIVIA!!!" in red marker.
Join {his} trivia team

House-sitting next week

Offer to keep {him} company house-sitting

Fishing alone on Saturday

Ask to come fishing

Works late on Fridays

Visit {him} on Friday nights

Karaoke night on Saturdays

Volunteer at the shelter

Throwing a party soon

Make sure you're invited
You got invited to {n}'s party and offered to stay late to help clean up.

Long runs on Sunday mornings

Ask to join {his} Sunday run

Hike: Eagle Ridge (solo!!) is written next weekend.
Ask about {his} hike

Invite yourself over while {he}'s alone
{n} said you should come over since {he} has the place to {him}self all month.
{n} said {he}'s enjoying the quiet.
Choir practice at night

Join {his} church choir

Shelter volunteer

Works out at midnight
A 24-hour gym membership card with a note: "Midnight is the only time it's empty."
Start going to {his} gym at midnight

A parking ticket from a trailhead way out in the mountains.
Ask about the trail
{n} told you all about {his} favorite remote trail and offered to take you.
{n} said {he} keeps that trail to {him}self.
Going to a reunion alone

Offer to be {his} plus-one

Facing eviction

Offer to help {him} move

{n} found family to help instead.
Wrote a love letter {he} never sent
A love letter to "whoever is out there," never sent.
Say exactly what the letter wished for
You said everything {n}'s letter hoped someone would say. {He} asked you on a date.
You quoted the letter almost word for word. {n} looked horrified.
Rents a boat slip at the marina
A bill for a boat slip at the marina.
Ask to see {his} boat
{n} took you out on {his} little boat. Out in the middle of the water, nobody can see you.
{n} said the boat is in the shop.
Wine club member
A wine club newsletter with tasting nights circled.
Go to {his} wine tastings
You and {n} are the last ones at every wine tasting. {He} usually needs a ride home.

Takes dance lessons
A receipt from a dance studio for late evening lessons.
Sign up for {his} dance lessons
You stepped on {n}'s feet until {he} asked for a new partner.
Bought earplugs and a sleep mask
An opened package of heavy-duty earplugs and a blackout sleep mask.
Talk about {his} sleep setup
{n} told you {he} can't hear or see a thing once {he}'s in bed.
{n} found the question oddly personal.
Church volunteer
A church newsletter thanking {n} for locking up every Sunday night.
Volunteer to help lock up
You help {n} lock up the church every Sunday night now. The building is empty and dark.
The pastor said they have enough volunteers.
Estranged from {his} father
An unopened letter from {his} father with "RETURN TO SENDER" written on it.
Talk about your own family drama
You and {n} bonded over terrible fathers. {He} says you're family now.
{n} snapped that {his} father is none of your business.
Has after-hours access at work
A new work badge with after-hours access.
Ask to see where {he} works
{n} gave you a late-night tour of {his} empty workplace.
{n} said {he}'d get fired for bringing someone in.
Can't sleep at night
A bottle of strong sleeping pills, almost empty, with a refill note stuck to it.
Bond over insomnia
You and {n} text each other at 3 AM when neither of you can sleep. {He} tells you when {he}'s finally knocked out.
{n} just said {he} was tired and went to bed.
Struggles with anxiety
Anxiety medication with a sticky note on the bottle that says "you're doing great."
Be a calming presence
You were endlessly patient and calm with {n}. {He} says {he} feels safe around you.
{n} got anxious just from how intense you were.
Recovering from surgery
Strong painkillers, with hospital discharge papers from a recent surgery folded around them.
Offer to help around the house
You offered to help {n} around the house while {he} recovers. {He} gave you a spare key.
{n}'s sister is already helping.
Muscle relaxers for a back injury and a note: "No lifting!"
You came over and moved {n}'s furniture. {He} said you can come by whenever.
{n} hired movers instead.
Gets seasick on {his} boat
Motion sickness pills next to a photo of {his} little fishing boat.
Offer to steer {his} boat
{n} was grateful to let you steer while {he} rested. Way out on the water.
{n} said {he}'s selling the boat.
Giant tubs of vitamins and electrolytes labeled "marathon training."
Ask to be {his} training partner
{n} was thrilled to have someone to run with at dawn.
You couldn't keep up. {n} trains alone again.
Sleeps during the day
Melatonin next to a night shift schedule. {He} sleeps all day.
Offer to bring {him} dinner before {his} shift
You bring {n} dinner before every night shift. {He} gets in your car without a second thought.
{n} said {he} eats at work.
Therapist says {he} needs friends
Antidepressants with a note from {his} therapist: "Try making one new friend this month."
Become {his} new friend
You became the friend {n}'s therapist told {him} to find. {He} lets you drive {him} everywhere.
{n} said {he}'s not ready for new people yet.
Parties hard
A drawer stuffed with hangover remedies and wristbands from nightclubs.
You partied with {n} until 4 AM. You were the one who got {him} home.
{n} ditched you at the first club.
Walks every night to quit smoking
Nicotine patches with a note: "walk it off, every night, 10 PM."
You and {n} take a walk every night at 10. The streets are always empty.
{n} said the walk is {his} time to think.
Can't see well at night
Eye drops and a broken pair of glasses with a note: "can't see anything after dark."
Offer to drive {him} at night
{n} gratefully lets you drive {him} home after dark.
{n} got new glasses before you could offer.
Hurt {his} knee hiking
A knee brace and painkillers from a fall on a hiking trail.
{n} was relieved to have someone to hike with in case {he} falls again.
{n} gave up hiking for a while.
Has nightmares
Pills labeled "for nightmares" and a bed with every light left on.
Talk about nightmares
{n} told you {he} sleeps so heavily on {his} pills that nothing wakes {him}.
{n} didn't want to relive {his} nightmares.
Nervous about dating
Heartburn medicine next to a book called "Dating for the Terrified."
Make dating feel easy
You made {n} feel completely at ease. {He} asked you over for a date at {his} place.
{n} panicked and cancelled.
Stress pills with a sticky note on the bottle: "quit this job."
Listen to {him} vent about work
You listened to {n} vent about {his} job every night after {his} shift. {He} waits for you in the empty parking lot.
{n} said {he} doesn't want to talk about work.
You waited around a bend on the trail where nobody would hear anything.
Miles from the nearest road, {n} never saw it coming.

A group of hikers came around the bend at the worst possible moment.
{n} slipped away down a ravine and ran for the trailhead.

The streetlight on {n}'s route had been out for weeks. You were waiting under it.

A neighbor came out to walk their dog right as you made your move.
{n} heard your footsteps and sprinted for the nearest porch light.

You waited by {n}'s car in the empty lot after class.
Everyone else left class early. You and {n} were the last ones out.

The instructor came out to the lot just as you made your move.
{n} locked {him}self in {his} car and leaned on the horn.

You stayed behind with {n} after everyone left the church.

The pastor walked back in to grab his coat.
{n} ran out the side door screaming for help.
On a date at your place
{n} came over for dinner and a movie. Nobody knew {he} was there.
You lit candles, poured drinks and waited until {n} relaxed.
{n} told everyone {he} was staying in tonight. {He} was at your place instead.
{n} saw something in your basement {he} shouldn't have and bolted.
{n}'s friend called to check on {him} and {he} ran for the door.

You let yourself in and waited in the dark for {n} to come home.
The back door opened without a sound. {n} was already asleep.
You were already inside when {n} got home.
{n} came home with a friend.
A floorboard creaked and {n} locked {him}self in the bathroom.

{n} took {his} pills and was out cold by midnight. {He} never woke up.

{n} slept straight through everything, just like {he} said {he} would.
{n} skipped {his} pills that night and woke up the moment you opened the door.
{n}'s phone alarm went off and {he} sat straight up in bed.

You waited for {n} in the dark alley behind the bar.

A bouncer came out for a smoke at the wrong moment.
{n} sobered up fast and ran back inside.

{n} hit the panic button behind the counter.

{n} grabbed {his} phone and locked {him}self in the bedroom.
